design_description: A bold identity-driven kit inspired by the team's glassmaking roots, combining premium aesthetics with predator-like aggression. The front features structured black stripes framing blue and green glass-textured panels, creating the appearance of stained or forged glass surfaces. Gold pinstripes, trims, and branding elevate the design while reinforcing a luxurious, high-end club image. The back switches to a cleaner black canvas, allowing the large white-gold numbering to stand out, while four metallic claw marks slash across the lower section as a signature statement. Overall, the design feels powerful, modern, and symbolic — blending craftsmanship, strength, and the panther identity of La Vidriera FC.
